sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Pachypodium baronii is a succulent shrub endemic to northern Madagascar, with a swollen base and spiny branches. An arborescent form can reach about 5 m.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The leaves cluster near the branch tips and are about 3–30 × 1.4–9 cm. Its red to crimson flowers distinguish it from P. rosulatum, which has yellow flowers.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No safe food use was documented in the sources consulted.
